title: Germany
subtitle: Spring gardens and castle ruins around Dagstuhl, followed by an afternoon among the streets and squares of Saarbrücken.

cover.alt: Schloss Dagstuhl and its chapel above a formal garden beneath a cloud-filled evening sky.
cover.caption: Schloss Dagstuhl and its chapel above a formal garden beneath a cloud-filled evening sky.

chapters.title: An evening around Dagstuhl
paragraphs: White walls and spring planting lead into the wooded slopes above Dagstuhl. Among the old castle walls, the last sunlight reaches the valley before the walk returns to the garden.

chapters.title: An afternoon in Saarbrücken
paragraphs: The next walk moves from the green slopes to a city centre of cafés, shopfronts and open squares. Trees soften the streets around the station.
